basic.note: First, previous, next, and last controls with a Page X of Y range.

density.note: Density is inherited from the theme system unless overridden.

pagination.description: Standalone pagination with page-size selection and unknown-total support.

examples.note: Start with known-total paging, then explore page size and cursor mode.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

page-size.note: Page sizes render through solaris-select. Changing size resets to the first page.

pagination.title: Pagination

unknown-total.note: Without a total, the range is compact and next follows hasMore.
